title: Lesson Allocation Tab – Matching List Views – Archived Lesson Allocation Remains Visible
description: Known behavior - Decision Table. A soft-deleted Lesson Allocation remains visible in every list view whose usual filters it matches. This documents the current List View limitation without treating the archived LA as active or selectable.
preconditions: - Student A has a Lesson Allocation for Course A, Require Allocation = True, Academic Year = 2024, with some but not all lessons assigned (status = Partially Assigned). It currently appears in the All, All_2024, and Partially_Assigned_2024 list views.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to the Lesson Allocation tab and confirms the LA appears in the All, All_2024, and Partially_Assigned_2024 list views"
2. "HQ or CM Staff fully removes the Student Package Order behind this Lesson Allocation so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff checks all 8 list views: All, All_2023, All_2024, Fully_Assigned_2024, None_Assigned_2024, Over_Assigned_2024, Partially_Assigned_2024, and Recently_Updated"
steps_result:
1. "The LA is visible in all three views"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows its archive timestamp populated and Last Modified Date updated to now"
3. "The archived Lesson Allocation remains visible in the four matching views (All, All_2024, Partially_Assigned_2024, and Recently_Updated). It is absent from the other four only because it does not satisfy their ordinary Academic Year or status filters."
steps_data:
1. "Archive timestamp blank; included"
2. "Archive timestamp = current timestamp"
3. "Require Allocation = True; Academic Year = 2024; Status = Partially Assigned; Last Modified Date = this week"

title: Lesson Allocation Tab – Restored Lesson Allocation – Remains Visible with Its Status Classification Unchanged
description: Known behavior regression - Decision Table. Because an archived Lesson Allocation remains visible in matching list views, restore clears the archive state without changing its list visibility or its status classification.
preconditions: - Student A's Lesson Allocation for Course A is archived, Academic Year = 2024, and Status = Partially Assigned. It remains visible in the matching list views.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff restores a living Student Package Order for Student A's Course A Student Course"
2. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to the Lesson Allocation tab and checks the All and All_2024 list views"
3. "HQ or CM Staff checks the Partially_Assigned_2024 list view"
steps_result:
1. "The same Lesson Allocation is unarchived and its archive timestamp is cleared"
2. "The Lesson Allocation remains visible in both; restore does not cause it to disappear or duplicate."
3. "The Lesson Allocation remains visible and retains the Partially Assigned classification; it is not moved to None_Assigned_2024 or Fully_Assigned_2024."
steps_data:
1. "Same Lesson Allocation record Id; archive timestamp = blank"
2. "Archive timestamp cleared; same Lesson Allocation record"
3. "Lesson Allocation Status = Partially Assigned before and after restore"
